summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 1: Gold Standard / Exemplar Pages v1. All Exemplar API endpoints working correctly (11/13 tests passed, 2 skipped due to all versions being exemplars). Frontend Exemplar Library page and PageWorkspace sidebar exemplar features working correctly.
passed_tests: GET /api/exemplars - returns all exemplars with by_family grouping and available_reason_tags
GET /api/exemplars?family=Core Hub - filters exemplars by family
GET /api/exemplars/family/{family} - returns exemplars for specific family with primary_exemplar
GET /api/exemplars/{id} - returns single exemplar with all required fields
POST /api/exemplars - returns 409 for duplicate version (already exemplar)
POST /api/exemplars/{id}/set-primary - sets exemplar as primary for its family
Exemplar data integrity - all required fields present in response
by_family grouping - accurate count per family
Exemplar Library page loads at /exemplars route
Family summary grid shows 8 family cards with counts
Exemplar cards display with tags, expand/collapse working
Family filter click and clear working
PageWorkspace sidebar shows Exemplar Status section
PageWorkspace Version History shows exemplar badge on versions
PageWorkspace shows quality score and recommendations
skipped_tests: POST /api/exemplars create full cycle - skipped because all versions are already exemplars
DELETE /api/exemplars/{id} - skipped because no non-exemplar versions available to create test exemplar
seed_data_creation: One exemplar exists for 'Temporary Satisfaction Home' (Core Hub, Primary, score 88) with reason tags: Emotional resonance, Trust-building excellence
context_for_next_testing_agent: Exemplar system fully functional. Homepage (ef54de19-6e5b-405e-9e80-5316b31ddd1f) has 1 version marked as primary exemplar for Core Hub family. Other pages have generated content but no versions in page_versions collection (versions are created on new generations). To test Mark Exemplar flow, generate new content on a page to create a version, then mark it as exemplar.
